say:1:1421446001:1.text: The burning stopped! Look, the scales are fading! This is a miracle!
say:1:1421446001:1.source_cn: 天啊，我、我真的不疼了，身上的鳞片也——神迹，是神迹啊！
say:1:1421446001:1.male: The burning stopped! Look, the scales are fading! This is a miracle!
say:1:1421446001:1.female: The burning stopped! Look, the scales are fading! This is a miracle!

say:3:1421446002:1.text: Oh! Sacred magic! Your radiance outshines even—
say:3:1421446002:1.source_cn: 噢！是伟大的魔法，您的恩赐光耀着我，何等至福——
say:3:1421446002:1.male: Oh! Sacred magic! Your radiance outshines even—
say:3:1421446002:1.female: Oh! Sacred magic! Your radiance outshines even—

say:5:1421446004:1.text: Ahem. Make way, please. Others await treatment.
say:5:1421446004:1.source_cn: 喂，既然好了就让个位置，还有人在后面等着呢。

say:6:1421446005:1.text: By the stars, Lord Ravion?! Your presence alone heals—
say:6:1421446005:1.source_cn: 天啊，这不是沙利叶大人吗！您的美貌犹如水晶般令我沉迷——

say:7:1421446006:1.source_cn: ……我说，我现在确实还戴着面具吧？面具没破吧？

say:8:1421446007:1.source_cn: 我现在是自由人了，沙利叶大人——

say:10:1421446003:1.text: Oh, you're certainly no ordinary priest! Could you be... our new High Priest? Someone so radiant deserves—
say:10:1421446003:1.source_cn: 啊，难道您会是新的主祭？天啊，我得到了如此的荣耀——
